title: DR1 tells the trader that JPG files are allowed and that ZIP files are not; the frontend's file requirements say neither.

finding.frontend: The file requirements hint has two bullets: a size and "a PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, PNG, XLS or XLSX". JPG is missing from that sentence even though the field accepts it — the list is built by de-duplicating the allowed types on MIME type, and .jpg shares image/jpeg with .jpeg, so it is dropped from the label while staying in the input's accept attribute and in the server-side check (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/upload-config.js:3-38). Nothing says ZIP is refused; a trader who picks one learns it only after submitting, from "The selected file must be a PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, PNG, XLS or XLSX".
finding.prototype: DR1's list has four bullets, two of which the frontend has no counterpart for: "PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, JPG, PNG, XLS or XLSX" names JPG explicitly, and "ZIP files are not allowed for security reasons" states the prohibition and the reason before the trader chooses a file (app/views/upload-documents.html:165-170).
finding.difference: Name JPG in the allowed-types sentence and add DR1's ZIP line to the file requirements list. The types sentence is generated rather than written, so the de-duplication that hides .jpg has to go — build the label from the extensions, not from the MIME types, or the two files that share image/jpeg will keep collapsing to one. The ZIP line is static copy for both languages. Neither changes what the field accepts.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding JPG or ZIP named anywhere in the frontend's file requirements before a file is submitted.
